def get_eff_k(k1, k2):
  """
  Returns effective bulk modulus

  Parameters
  ----------
  k1: float
      First bulk modulus
  k2 : float
      Second bulk modulus

  Returns
  -------
  float
      Effective bulk modulus
  """
  return 2. * k1 * k2 / (k1 + k2)
